## A culture's glossary

**Key:** _Lit._ Liturgic Language; _Nor._ Nordmal Language; _n._ noun; _m._ masculine; • a common word, which a player is expected to know by heart.

### B

**blood-field** Ground torn by a battle. — [[demo-note-lore-provnzclt|Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}

### C

**Captain of the Guard** (_Royal Guard_) Leads the guard. — [[demo-note-affiliation-guard|Royal Guard]]{.lexical-ref}

### D

**Duc** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) A peer of the realm. — [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}

### E

**Écuyer Tranchant** (_Duchy of Aubrac_) Carves and serves at the duke's table. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]]{.lexical-ref}

### K

**Knight-Captain** **1** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) A knight who leads a company. **2** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) Commands the guard in the field. — [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}, [[demo-note-being-mara|Mara]]{.lexical-ref}

### L

**Lord Steward** (_Duchy of Aubrac, Kingdom of Provenzia_) Keeps the household. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]]{.lexical-ref}, [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}, Aran

### O

**'ostal** A household and its hearth. — [[demo-note-lore-provnzclt|Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}

**Ordained Priest** _Lit._ (_Church of the Rite_) Ordained to serve a parish. — [[demo-note-affiliation-church|Church of the Rite]]{.lexical-ref}

### S

• **[[demo-note-skill-provnzlng#word-61d2eab55463a6c46a0d1ae1d4d8c4391f1651a63f0213f5c93dc2cd3419c2e7|solmère]]{.lexical-ref}** /sol-MEH-reh/ _n. m._ Longing; the ache for a time that is gone. — [[demo-note-lore-lastshrine|The Song of the Last Shrine]]{.lexical-ref}

**Struck from the Roll** (_Royal Guard_) Dismissed in disgrace. — [[demo-note-affiliation-guard|Royal Guard]]{.lexical-ref}

• **Subject** **1** (_Duchy of Aubrac_) Owes the duke fealty. **2** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) Owes the crown fealty. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]]{.lexical-ref}, [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}, [[demo-note-lore-provnzclt|Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}

**Sworn Knight** **1** (_Duchy of Aubrac_) Holds land of the duke. **2** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) Holds land of the crown. **3** A knight bound by oath to a lord. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]]{.lexical-ref}, [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}, Aran, [[demo-note-lore-provnzclt|Provenzia]]{.lexical-ref}

### W

**Watch-Captain** _Nor._ (_The Northern Watch_) Commands a tower of the wall. — [[demo-note-affiliation-watch|The Northern Watch]]{.lexical-ref}
